summary: Tested 3 new EXPORT endpoints (GET /api/retas/{id}/rol/csv, GET /api/retas/{id}/clasificacion/csv, GET /api/retas/{id}/clasificacion/pdf) + regression on login, create reta, existing rol PDF, and clasificacion endpoint. 16/16 pytest cases PASS. All endpoints behave as specified: 401 without token, 200 + correct content-type/body with admin Bearer JWT, 404 on missing retas. CSV files include UTF-8 BOM, expected headers, expected row counts. PDF files start with %PDF magic, exceed 1KB, and the populated-results PDF is larger than the empty-standings PDF (podium + table vs placeholder message).
critical_code_review_comments: export_router.py is clean and consistent with existing style (uses StreamingResponse, BOM-prefixed CSV, helper _get_reta_or_404). Uses get_current_admin → properly admin-gated.
pdf_generator.generar_pdf_clasificacion correctly handles empty standings (prints 'Aún no hay resultados capturados para esta reta.' instead of crashing on empty podium).
Defensive coding present: pa/pb padded to length 2 in rol/csv; logo bytes decoded inside try/except.
Suggestion (non-blocking): CSV endpoints use limit(2000) on resultados — fine for current scale, but document this cap in API docs if export of massive datasets becomes a use case.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test retas (TEST_Export_Reta, TEST_Empty_Pdf, TEST_Regression_Reta) and 3 resultados during testing. Test retas cleaned up: fixture deleted TEST_Export_Reta via DELETE /api/retas/{id}; the remaining TEST_Empty_Pdf and TEST_Regression_Reta were dropped via a direct MongoDB cleanup script after pytest. DB is back to clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_export_endpoints.py is reusable. Module-scoped admin_token + test_reta + reta_with_results fixtures; uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env. Note: DELETE /api/retas/{id} exists and works (returned 200 during cleanup).
